versions.changelog: Ecwid REST API v3 skill covering 12 verified endpoints: products, orders, customers, categories, discount coupons, promotions, abandoned carts, and store profile. All endpoints tested against a live Ecwid store. Includes YAML frontmatter with credential declarations, security best practices section recommending read-only token scopes, and full parameter/response documentation sourced from official Ecwid docs.

Now includes a security best practices section that explicitly recommends:

✅ Using read-only scopes and GET only by default
✅ Never using a full admin token unnecessarily
✅ Testing with a sandbox store first
✅ Rotating tokens if exposed
✅ Link to official Ecwid auth docs
